description: Break the 22 recorded ASNSD1 interactions down by source reference to separate in vitro peptide-based PDZ assays from cell-based affinity purification, and plot the C-terminal motif conservation result.
code:
import pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from collections import Counter
A = pd.read_csv("quickgo_ASNSD1_Q9NWL6.csv")
pb = A[A.goId == "GO:0005515"]
P = pd.read_csv("asnsd1_interaction_partners.csv").set_index("acc")
TITLE = {"PMID:30126976": "Proteome-wide analysis of phospho-regulated PDZ domain interactions (in vitro peptide array)",
         "PMID:33961781": "Dual proteome-scale networks / BioPlex (cell-based AP-MS)",
         "PMID:36115835": "Quantitative fragmentomics, affinity mapping of interactomes (in vitro holdup)"}
print("=== ASNSD1 interactions by source ===")
for ref, sub in pb.groupby("ref"):
    accs = sorted({w for w in sub.withFrom.dropna() if str(w).strip()})
    genes = [P.loc[a, "gene"] if a in P.index else a for a in accs]
    npdz = sum(1 for a in accs if a in P.index and P.loc[a, "n_PDZ"] > 0)
    print(f"\n{ref}  n={len(accs)}  PDZ-containing: {npdz}/{len(accs)}")
    print(f"   {TITLE.get(ref,'?')}")
    print(f"   partners: {', '.join(sorted(genes))}")

orth = pd.read_csv("asnsd1_vertebrate_orthologs.csv")
prim = ["Homo sapiens", "Pan troglodytes", "Macaca mulatta", "Macaca fascicularis"]
sub = orth[orth.org.isin(prim + ["Mus musculus", "Rattus norvegicus", "Bos taurus",
                                 "Gallus gallus", "Danio rerio", "Xenopus tropicalis"])]
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8.2, 4.2))
y = list(range(len(sub)))[::-1]
cols = ["#1f7a5a" if o in prim else "#999999" for o in sub.org]
ax.barh(y, [1]*len(sub), color=cols)
for yy, (_, r) in zip(y, sub.iterrows()):
    ax.text(0.02, yy, f"{r.org}", va="center", fontsize=8, color="white", fontweight="bold")
    ax.text(0.98, yy, r.seq[-6:], va="center", ha="right", fontsize=9, family="monospace", color="white")
ax.set_xticks([]); ax.set_yticks([])
ax.set_title("Last six residues of ASNSD1.\nThe class I PDZ-binding motif (ending ETKL) is present only in primates (green);\n"
             "2.7% of 437 vertebrate orthologs carry any class I motif", fontsize=10)
for s in ax.spines.values(): s.set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
